datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2011 in South Sudan. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity scenarios at different time periods, with metadata including classification scale, collection date, and assistance eligibility indicators.
